name: Anna Petrovskaya
text: Excellent range of materials. Staff helped me find everything for the repair without any fuss. Prices matched the website. Will be back.

name: Sergey Kolpakov
text: Delivery arrived on time and the driver helped move the OSB-3 sheets to the entrance. The only downside was the delivery time was only confirmed on the morning itself.

name: Irina Sharapova
text: Great stock of plasterboard and tile adhesive. Bought 20 bags and they were all the same production batch — important for consistent finish colour.

name: Dmitry Volkov
text: Asked the floor staff about load-bearing ratings for different beam sizes. They knew their stuff and pointed me to the right section immediately. Saved me a trip back.

name: Olga Nesterenko
text: Wide selection of paint and primers. Found the exact RAL colour I needed. Would give five stars but one tin had a dented lid — staff swapped it without question.

name: Arman Bekov
text: Ordered a bulk pallet of cement and sand. Everything arrived shrink-wrapped and undamaged. Price per bag is noticeably cheaper than the hardware shops nearby.

name: Vladimir Chuchko
text: Good construction store with a large selection of repair and building materials. Prices are reasonable, many items in stock. Staff are polite, helped me find everything I needed and answered all my questions.

name: BaurzHan
text: Excellent store! Large selection of quality materials at acceptable prices. Polite staff helped me choose everything and answered all questions thoroughly. Fast order processing and high-level service overall.

name: Elena Konstantinovna
text: Excellent materials shop with a large selection — everything is quality and pleasantly priced. Goods matched the description and were well-packaged without any damage. Service was fast, polite, and problem-free.

name: Oiiia Uiiia
text: Ordered in the morning and received delivery by noon. They have loaders, delivery is affordable, and all the necessary documents were provided. Good service all round.

name: Ulfhender Jörmungand
text: Left my tools there by accident and called to explain the situation. After a brief conversation they organised delivery back to me without any unnecessary discussion. Very professional staff.

name: Sveta
text: Many thanks to manager Azamat — he explained everything clearly, gave good advice, arranged fast delivery, and the installation cost was very affordable.

name: Azat Kanatbekov
text: Purchased dry mixes — Rotband, Glatt, and Finish — all good quality. The Kazakhstani gypsum plaster in particular is excellent quality and came in cheaper than I expected.

name: Nursultan Kasymov
text: Lowest prices in the city combined with an excellent assortment. I now buy all my construction materials exclusively here.

name: Rustembek Abuev
text: Wholesale prices and the items I need are always in stock. If something is temporarily unavailable, they immediately let you know when it will arrive. Very reliable.

name: Darya Kh.
text: Pleasantly surprised by the service here. Manager Azamat and his colleagues are genuinely interested in helping customers, not just making a sale. Prices are reasonable too.

name: Denis Ognyov
text: Store has everything you need and orders are processed fast. I had read some complaints about delivery, but my experience was the opposite — drivers were professional, loaders were excellent, everything was handled quickly and carefully.

name: Walter
text: Unassuming from the outside but a genuinely solid selection inside. Need nails — they have it. Need drywall — got it. Have repeatedly ordered materials via WhatsApp and they always deliver. Simply great!

name: A. V.
text: Excellent store with everything for construction. Delivery and unloading were fast and efficient. Most importantly, prices are excellent — I monitored prices across the city and this is the best. Highly recommend.

name: sososchka
text: Excellent store, always has everything in stock. Good young sellers who are genuinely pleasant to deal with. A special mention for seller Tlek and his assistant Vladimir — very helpful.

name: Evgeny
text: Thank you for first-class service and for helping me sort out all the material purchasing and delivery questions. Will recommend this store to everyone.

name: Mikhail
text: Built a fence at the dacha from corrugated sheets and bought everything here — metal, sheets, cement, and sand. Delivery was timely and the prices were affordable. Very satisfied.

name: Renat Yermekbayev
text: Excellent store — the team really came through for us! Thank you for the great service and the low prices. Will definitely be back.

name: Mans
text: Bought four masonry grids but in the rush only loaded two. Came back the next day and the seller told me they had kept the remaining two aside. Thank you for the honesty — it means a lot.
